unit.why: A single narrative. R. Berish of Oshpitzin promises a childless rich man a son, then explains on the journey to the circumcision why he showed no fear when the wagon nearly overturned.

stories.start_quote: בכפר א׳ סמוך לאושפצין הי׳ שם
stories.summary_en: R. Berish of Oshpitzin promises a rich man who has only daughters a son, on condition that he be the sandak. On the bad road to the circumcision their wagon nearly overturns, and he tells the frightened intermediary that his dead master's soul is always with him and holds the wagon up.
